title: Profile
content: I am a full-stack development learner and UI/UX designer building practical web applications with React, Vite, Node.js, Express and MongoDB. I enjoy creating clean, modern and usable products.

title: Projects
content: Projects include a To-Do app, Task Manager, RAG AI Chatbot, Job Sphere, Bootcamp Management System, Role-Based Management System, Color Palette project, Toggle project and Social Proof Section. I have also worked on React portfolio/blog style applications.

title: UX and UI Work
content: My design work includes Daily UI challenges 1-30, wireframes and a UX case study. I focus on modern, human-looking interfaces, clear hierarchy, responsive layouts and practical interaction design.

title: Certificates
content: Certificates include Full-Stack Development by CSEC, Data Literacy and AI Literacy.

title: Technology
content: Frontend: React with Vite and JavaScript. Backend: Node.js with Express. Database: MongoDB. UI work can use Tailwind CSS and component libraries where appropriate.

title: Career Goals
content: The portfolio is being built as a professional digital resume and proof of work for recruiters, clients and hiring managers, aligned with the Future Interns Full Stack Web Development Task 1.
